requirements.businessContext: Auction Core is the 'court' of the auction-format league — the live session machine, the per-player bidding round, the snake-order nomination loop, the auto-nominate wishlist that fires on missed nominations, and the read APIs that surface squad / teams / players / unsold pool / live status. It owns session lifecycle (pending → active → paused → completed) for the 'initial' and 'mini-auction' session types only; the club-auction lifecycle is module 13. It owns bid placement (anti-snipe, min-increment, squad-rule pre-checks) but defers purse / payout / synergy math to module 11, marketplace/trade locking to module 12, and slot-unlock / penalty-redeem economics to module 13. Auction standings ranking belongs to module 07. This module also covers the admin reset-auction endpoint that wipes the auction back to initial or a chosen mini-cycle.

userStories.iWant: to create an initial player-auction session for a league with a randomised snake order
userStories.soThat: the league's first auction can begin from a fair, randomised nomination order

userStories.iWant: to create a mini-auction session whose snake order is reverse season standings
userStories.soThat: bottom-ranked teams nominate first in mid-season refreshes

userStories.iWant: to start, pause, resume, and complete an existing auction session
userStories.soThat: I can run a multi-day auction across breaks and finalise it on demand

userStories.iWant: pause/resume to preserve the remaining time on the nomination deadline and every open bid
userStories.soThat: a 60s window paused with 10s left resumes with 10s left (not 0, not a fresh 60)

userStories.iWant: to nominate a PL player on my turn with an optional starting bid
userStories.soThat: I control which player goes up next and at what floor price

userStories.iWant: to place a bid that beats the current high bid by at least the minimum increment
userStories.soThat: I can compete for a nominated player up to my available purse

userStories.iWant: the bid timer to extend (anti-snipe) when a bid lands inside the closing window
userStories.soThat: I can't be sniped by a last-second bid I never had a chance to counter

userStories.iWant: to maintain a priority-ordered wishlist of players I want
userStories.soThat: if my nomination timer expires the system auto-nominates the top unowned wishlist entry on my behalf

userStories.iWant: to reorder my wishlist and remove entries
userStories.soThat: I can refine auto-nomination priority as the auction progresses

userStories.iWant: a real-time SSE stream of session/bid/nomination events
userStories.soThat: my UI updates within seconds without polling

userStories.iWant: to see my full squad with purchase price, points, FMV, position counts, and slot status
userStories.soThat: I can plan my next nomination/bid against my squad constraints

userStories.iWant: to browse the player catalog filtered by position, PL club, ownership and search
userStories.soThat: I can scout targets in or out of the live auction

userStories.iWant: to see who went unsold in the most recent auction session
userStories.soThat: I can add them to my wishlist before the next cycle

userStories.iWant: to see a per-bid event history for the current session
userStories.soThat: I can audit how each player's price was reached and who sold to whom

userStories.iWant: a public 'is the auction live?' indicator for the league
userStories.soThat: I can land directly on the auction view when a session is in progress without authenticating

userStories.iWant: to reset the auction either fully (back to initial) or back to before a specific mini-auction cycle
userStories.soThat: I can re-run a corrupted auction without manually wiping every table

userStories.iWant: starting a session in a simulated league to auto-allocate players via snake draft
userStories.soThat: I can populate post-auction state for QA without running a live auction

businessRules.rule: POST /api/auction/session requires superadmin (isSuperAdmin) — returns 403 otherwise. Body must include leagueId and action; missing either returns 400.
Session APIs only accept leagues with format='auction'; any other format returns 400 'Not an auction league'.

Allowed session creation order per league is club-auction → initial → mini-auction. Creating an 'initial' session when a prior initial already exists, or before clubAuctionEnabled leagues have completed their club auction, returns 409.
Creating a 'mini-auction' before a 'completed' initial-auction session exists in the league returns 409.
Session creation requires at least one non-ghost team in the league; an empty roster returns 400 'No teams in league'.

For type='initial', snakeOrder is generated by sorting non-ghost teams by Math.random() (fully randomised). For type='mini-auction', snakeOrder is generated by generateSnakeOrder() sorting teams by descending rank — worst rank first.
POST /api/auction/session action=create validates bidTimerSeconds is an integer in [5, 600] when supplied; out-of-range or non-integer values return HTTP 400. Undefined falls back to 20s default.

Session state machine. Allowed status transitions: start: pending|paused → active; pause: active → paused; resume: paused → active; complete: active|paused → completed. Any other (status, action) pair returns 400.
Action='schedule' is only allowed on a 'pending' session; updates scheduledAt only and does not transition status.
On pause, the server stores pausedAt=now on the session row.

On resume, the server shifts the session's nominationDeadline AND every open bid's expiresAt forward by (now - pausedAt) ms, then clears pausedAt. Legacy paused rows without pausedAt are resumed without a shift.
On first-time start of a player auction (not resume), the system sets the nomination deadline for the current nominator via setNominationDeadline.

On first-time start (not resume) of any auction session, the league's non-completed/non-cancelled trade proposals (status in 'pending','accepted') are bulk-cancelled via purgePendingTrades to lock the marketplace for the auction.
On first-time start of a 'mini-auction' (not resume), finalizePendingReleasesNow runs for the session's cycleNumber before the auction begins.
When status transitions to 'completed', writeAuctionCompleteSnapshot is fired-and-forgotten. Failures are logged but do not block completion.

If the league.isSimulated is true and an admin starts (action='start') a session for the first time, the route runs simulateAuction (or simulateClubAuction for club sessions) and short-circuits with status='completed' instead of the live nomination/bid flow.

simulateAuction caps per-team draft size at effectiveMaxSquadSize(team.penaltySlots, team.bonusSlots) — i.e., 15 base + bonusSlots - penaltySlots. Teams with bonusSlots > 0 from pre-auction unlocks now draft their full purchased squad in simulation, matching live auction behaviour.
GET /api/auction/session requires a verified session cookie; returns 401 if unauthenticated. Requires leagueId query param (400 otherwise).

GET /api/auction/session calls resolveExpiredBids as a safety net on the active/paused session: any auctionBids row with status='open' and expiresAt < now is resolved (sold or unsold) and, if sold, advanceNominator is called. This catches expirations that SSE missed.
POST /api/auction/nominate requires either a verified team session OR superadmin; returns 401 otherwise. Body must include sessionId + fplElementId + playerName (400 otherwise).
Nominate returns 400 if the session is not status='active'. Club-auction sessions (type=CLUB_AUCTION_SESSION_TYPE) reject manual nominate calls with 400 — clubs are system-nominated.

Non-admin nominate is rejected with 403 'Not your turn to nominate' unless the caller's team id equals snakeOrder[currentNominatorIndex]. The check is performed twice: once before the safety-net stale-bid resolution and once after (the safety net can advance the nominator).
Nominate returns 400 if any other auctionBids row is still status='open' on the session (after the safety-net pass), and 409 if the player is already owned (via ownerOfPlayer).
Default starting bid is 500_000 (DEFAULT_MIN_BID). A nominator may pass minBid to override, but only if their available purse covers it; insufficient purse returns 400.
Non-admin nominate enforces squad cap + position-feasibility via countsFromOwnership/validateAddPlayer on the nominator. Admins skip these pre-checks.

When a nomination succeeds the system inserts auctionBids (status='open', currentHighBidderId=nominator, expiresAt=now+bidTimer) AND auctionBidLogs (type='nomination', amount=startingBid), and clears nominationDeadline on the session.
POST /api/auction/bid requires a verified team session (session.type='team'); admin/non-team returns 401. Body must include sessionId and numeric bidAmount (400 otherwise).
Bid is rejected with 400 when the session is not 'active', 403 when the bidder's team is not in the session's league, and 400 when there is no open bid item.
Bid is rejected with 400 'Auction timer has expired' if now > expiresAt + 2_000ms (2s grace window for in-flight requests).
MIN_BID_INCREMENT is 100_000. Bids below currentHighBid + 100_000 are rejected with 400 stating the minimum.
Available purse is computed as calculatePurse(initialBudget, totalIncome, totalSpent, totalRefunds). Bid amounts exceeding available purse return 400 'Insufficient purse'.

For player auctions, bid validation also enforces the bidder's squad cap + position feasibility (validateAddPlayer using penaltySlots, bonusSlots, element_type) against the player being bid on. Unknown FPL element returns 400.

Anti-snipe: if remaining time on the open bid is ≤ ANTI_SNIPE_WINDOW_MS (5_000), expiresAt is pushed to min(currentExpiresAt + ANTI_SNIPE_EXTENSION_MS (10_000), now + bidTimerSeconds*1000). Bids landing outside the window do NOT extend the timer.
Successful bid updates auctionBids.currentHighBid/currentHighBidderId/expiresAt/updatedAt and appends an auctionBidLogs row with type='bid'. All under a single DB transaction.

GET /api/auction/session/stream is an SSE endpoint that polls auctionSessions + auctionBids every POLL_INTERVAL_MS (2000ms) and emits heartbeat every HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS (15000ms). Required query: sessionId (400 otherwise).

SSE event types emitted: session-status, auction-state, bid-placed (on highBidder/highBid change), sold, unsold, waiting (deduped per nominator+deadline snapshot), auto-nominated, penalised, skipped-full, session-complete, heartbeat, error.

On SSE detect of expiresAt + 2s elapsed, resolveExpiredBid runs. For player auctions every expired bid is resolved as sold (nominator is the default floor bidder). On sold, advanceNominator runs BEFORE the 'sold' event is sent so clients see the new nominator on refresh.

When a sold bid is finalized, auctionOwnership is inserted (status='active', acquiredGw=0, purchasePrice=winning bid), the winner's purse is debited and totalSpent credited atomically, an auctionBidLogs row with type='sold' is appended, and the player is deleted from EVERY team's auctionWishlists in the league.

Double-sell guard: if an active auctionOwnership row already exists for the same fplElementId at finalisation time, the bid is marked status='cancelled-duplicate' with a cancelled-duplicate log row, no ownership is inserted, no purse is deducted, and advanceNominator is NOT called by this path.

advanceNominator walks the snakeOrder forward, skipping any team whose squad is already full (counts.total >= effectiveMaxSquadSize). The first eligible team becomes the new nominator and its nominationDeadline is set to now+nominationTimeoutSeconds. If no team is eligible the session auto-completes (status='completed', nominationDeadline=null) and writeAuctionCompleteSnapshot fires.

Composition audit at all-teams-full auto-completion: if any team finishes with fewer than the MIN_QUOTA 1 GKP / 3 DEF / 3 MID / 1 FWD, an auditLogs row with type='AUCTION_COMPLETED_COMPOSITION_WARNING' is inserted. This never blocks completion.

Nomination timeout handling (SSE detects nominationDeadline passed): the SSE stream atomically claims the timeout by nulling nominationDeadline (single-winner race). The winner calls handleNominationTimeout which (a) skips squad-full nominators with 'skipped-full' (no penalty), (b) tries autoNominateFromWishlist (top-priority unowned, affordable, position-feasible) and on success returns 'auto-nominated', or (c) applies a penalty (teamPenalties row + teams.penaltySlots++) and advances, returning 'penalised'.

GET /api/auction/wishlist requires authentication and either teamId match (session.id === teamId) or superadmin; otherwise 403. teamId query param is required (400). Result is ordered by priority asc and silently deduplicates by fplElementId, deleting the lower-priority duplicates as a read-time side effect. // CODE-CONFIRMED: dedupe-on-GET performs DB DELETEs on a read — surprising side-effect, but harmless data hygiene.

POST /api/auction/wishlist accepts either single ({fplElementId, playerName}) or bulk ({players: [...]}) shape; missing both shapes returns 400. Duplicates against existing wishlist fplElementIds are silently skipped — response carries {inserted, skipped} counts. Priorities are appended starting at MAX(priority)+1.
PATCH /api/auction/wishlist updates each items[i].priority where id and teamId match. DELETE /api/auction/wishlist deletes one wishlist row by (id, teamId). Both require teamId match or superadmin.

GET /api/auction/squad requires authentication. The squad result EXCLUDES status='released' rows and surfaces active + deadwood. FMV is calculated per-player from purchasePrice + cumulative RAW points (synergy never compounds into FMV).

GET /api/auction/squad surfaces slotStatus = { active, effectiveMax, baseCap=15, bonusSlots, penaltySlots, open, lockedCount=MAX_BONUS_SLOTS-bonusSlots, nextUnlockCost, canUnlock, unlockBlockedReason, redeemableCost, canRedeem, initialAuctionCompleted }. canUnlock requires the initial auction to be 'completed' AND availablePurse ≥ nextUnlockCost.

GET /api/auction/teams returns each team with rank, totalPoints, purse, squadValue (sum of FMV), squadSize, penaltySlots, bonusSlots, effectiveMax (15 + bonus - penalty), topPerformer, isMine (vs requesting team) and ownedClub. Authentication is NOT required for this endpoint.

GET /api/auction/players requires authentication. Pagination: page≥1, pageSize 10–100 (default 50). gameweek must be 1–38 (default 38). Filters: position (1–4), plTeam (FPL team id), ownership ('all'|'free'|'mine'|<teamId>), search (case-insensitive substring on web_name).

GET /api/auction/unsold returns auctionBids rows with status='unsold' from the league's most-recent auctionSessions row (by createdAt desc). If no session exists returns {unsold: []}. Requires authentication.

GET /api/auction/bid-history is unauthenticated and returns ONLY status='sold' or 'unsold' bids for the session (open/cancelled filtered out), newest first, each augmented with its auctionBidLogs entries ordered by createdAt asc.

GET /api/auction/live-status is public (no auth). Accepts ?leagueSlug or ?leagueId (400 if neither). Returns {live, leagueId, sessionId, status} where live=true iff the league has an auctionSessions row with status in ('active','paused'). Non-auction leagues return live:false.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-auction requires getAuthorizedLeagueId (admin scope for that league) — 403 otherwise. Body must include resetTo (400 otherwise). resetTo must be 'initial' or 'mini-N' (any other value returns 400).

resetTo='initial' deletes ALL auctionBidLogs, auctionBids, auctionSessions, auctionOwnership, auctionClubOwnership, teamPenalties, auctionScores and tradeProposals for the league. Then resets every team's totalSpent=0, totalRefunds=0, totalIncome=0, penaltySlots=0, bonusSlots=0, purse=initialBudget. Wishlists are deliberately PRESERVED across resets.

resetTo='mini-N' deletes only sessions with cycleNumber ≥ N (and their bidLogs/bids) plus the auctionOwnership rows whose fplElementIds were 'sold' in those deleted sessions. Each team's totalSpent is recomputed from surviving active ownerships and penaltySlots is reset to 0. Wishlists are PRESERVED.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-auction wipes the slot-unlock audit trail (teamSlotUnlocks) for the league in the same flow as the rest of the auction state (auctionOwnership, auctionClubOwnership, teamPenalties, auctionBids, auctionSessions, etc.). This keeps teams.bonusSlots=0 in lockstep with an empty audit trail.

autoNominateFromWishlist walks the wishlist in priority order and skips any entry that is (a) owned by some team (ownerOfPlayer), (b) unaffordable at DEFAULT_MIN_BID against availablePurse, (c) unknown to FPL, or (d) infeasible (validateAddPlayer). Returns true on first successful nomination, false when the wishlist is exhausted or squad already full.
applyNominationPenalty inserts a teamPenalties row tagged with the session's cycleNumber (used later by redeem pricing) and increments teams.penaltySlots by 1.

When isSimulated is true on a Complete-tier league with one or more teams holding bonusSlots > 0, simulateAuction produces ownership counts equal to (15 + bonusSlots - penaltySlots) per team. Previously this matched only when bonusSlots=0 due to the missing argument to effectiveMaxSquadSize.

POST /api/auction/session action=create validates nominationTimeoutSeconds is an integer in [5, 3600] when supplied; out-of-range or non-integer values return HTTP 400. Undefined falls back to 60s default.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am a non-admin team
acceptanceCriteria.then: I get 403 'Admin access required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An admin POSTs to /api/auction/session against a league with format='tvt'
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Not an auction league'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An auction league with no prior auction sessions and clubAuctionEnabled=true
acceptanceCriteria.when: admin creates type='initial' before any club-auction has completed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 409 referencing the club-auction → initial → mini-auction order

acceptanceCriteria.given: An auction league whose initial-auction session exists but is status='active'
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 409 'Initial auction must be completed before creating a mini-auction'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An auction league with zero non-ghost teams
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'No teams in league' and no auctionSessions row is inserted

acceptanceCriteria.given: An auction league with 8 non-ghost teams
acceptanceCriteria.when: admin creates type='initial' twice in succession
acceptanceCriteria.then: the two persisted snakeOrders are random and differ (not deterministic by team id), each contains exactly the 8 ids once

acceptanceCriteria.given: Teams with ranks [1,2,3,4]
acceptanceCriteria.then: the persisted snakeOrder lists the rank=4 team first and the rank=1 team last

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin creates a session with no timer overrides
acceptanceCriteria.when: the session row is read back
acceptanceCriteria.then: bidTimerSeconds=20 and nominationTimeoutSeconds=60

acceptanceCriteria.given: A session in status='completed'
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Cannot start a session in completed status'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A session in status='active'
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Can only schedule pending sessions'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An active session with nominationDeadline=now+45s and an open bid expiring in 12s
acceptanceCriteria.then: nominationDeadline shifts to now+45s+30s and the open bid expiresAt shifts forward by 30s; pausedAt is cleared to null

acceptanceCriteria.given: An active session with no nominationDeadline (post-nomination) and one open bid
acceptanceCriteria.then: the open bid's expiresAt advances by 10s; nominationDeadline remains null; pausedAt cleared

acceptanceCriteria.given: A pending player-auction session being started for the first time
acceptanceCriteria.then: setNominationDeadline runs (current nominator gets a deadline) AND purgePendingTrades runs (league trade proposals in pending/accepted flip to cancelled)

acceptanceCriteria.given: A pending mini-auction session for cycleNumber=2 being started
acceptanceCriteria.then: finalizePendingReleasesNow runs for gw=2 BEFORE the bid timer is set

acceptanceCriteria.given: A live (non-simulated) session is force-completed by admin
acceptanceCriteria.then: writeAuctionCompleteSnapshot is invoked (idempotent — no duplicate snapshot if already taken)

acceptanceCriteria.given: A simulated league with a pending player-auction session
acceptanceCriteria.then: simulateAuction runs, the response carries simulated:true + playersAssigned count, and the session row ends status='completed'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A simulated 8-team league with initialBudget=£100M
acceptanceCriteria.then: each team has up to MAX_SQUAD_SIZE (15) auctionOwnership rows, every fplElementId is unique across the league, and per-team totalSpent equals sum of purchasePrice

acceptanceCriteria.given: Unauthenticated user
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 401 'Unauthorized'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An active session with one auctionBids row status='open' whose expiresAt was 60s ago and no SSE listener
acceptanceCriteria.then: the bid is resolved (status='sold'), auctionOwnership inserted for the winner, and currentBid in the response reflects the next (or no) open bid

acceptanceCriteria.given: An unauthenticated request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 401 'Authentication required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An active club-auction session
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Club auctions are system-nominated...'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A non-admin team that is NOT snakeOrder[currentNominatorIndex]
acceptanceCriteria.when: they POST /api/auction/nominate with a valid body
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Not your turn to nominate'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An active session with an open bid for player X still in progress
acceptanceCriteria.when: the current nominator POSTs a nominate for player Y
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Another item is still open for bidding'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A player already in auctionOwnership for team A in this league
acceptanceCriteria.when: the current nominator POSTs a nominate for that fplElementId
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 409 'Player is already owned by another team'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A non-admin nominator with availablePurse=£300K nominating a player with minBid=£500K
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Insufficient purse ...'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A nominator with a full squad of 15
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Squad is full (15 players)'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A successful nomination
acceptanceCriteria.then: an auctionBids row exists (status='open', currentHighBidderId=nominator, expiresAt≈now+bidTimerSeconds) AND an auctionBidLogs type='nomination' row exists AND the session's nominationDeadline is null

acceptanceCriteria.given: A non-team session (superadmin) POSTing /api/auction/bid
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 401 'Team authentication required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A team in league A trying to bid on session in league B
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Team not in this league'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An open bid whose expiresAt was 3 seconds ago
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Auction timer has expired'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An open bid with currentHighBid=£1,000,000
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Minimum bid is 1,100,000'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A team with available purse £600K
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Insufficient purse'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A team with 14 active ownerships including 1 GK, 3 DEF, 2 MID, 4 FWD bidding on an additional FWD
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 with the squad-rule error from validateAddPlayer

acceptanceCriteria.given: An open bid with 15s remaining (bidTimerSeconds=20)
acceptanceCriteria.when: a team places a valid bid
acceptanceCriteria.then: expiresAt does NOT extend (bid landed outside the 5s window)

acceptanceCriteria.given: An open bid with 3s remaining
acceptanceCriteria.when: a team places a valid bid
acceptanceCriteria.then: expiresAt extends by ANTI_SNIPE_EXTENSION_MS (10s) but capped at now + bidTimerSeconds*1000

acceptanceCriteria.given: A successful bid
acceptanceCriteria.then: auctionBids has updated currentHighBid/currentHighBidderId AND a new auctionBidLogs row with type='bid' exists

acceptanceCriteria.given: An SSE client connected with no sessionId
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'sessionId is required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An SSE client on an active session
acceptanceCriteria.when: another team places a bid that changes currentHighBidderId
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stream emits an 'auction-state' event followed by a 'bid-placed' event with the new amount/bidder

acceptanceCriteria.given: An SSE client on a session whose open bid just expired
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stream emits 'sold' with bidId, fplElementId, finalBid, winnerId AND the session's currentNominatorIndex has advanced BEFORE the event is emitted

acceptanceCriteria.given: A sold expiration on player X bought by team A for £2.5M
acceptanceCriteria.then: auctionOwnership has the new row (status='active', purchasePrice=2_500_000, acquiredGw=0), teams.purse decreases by £2.5M, teams.totalSpent increases by £2.5M, auctionBidLogs gets a type='sold' row, and auctionWishlists has zero rows for fplElementId X across all teams in the league

acceptanceCriteria.given: Two open bids race-resolving for the same fplElementId
acceptanceCriteria.when: the second resolveBidToSold finds an existing active ownership
acceptanceCriteria.then: the second bid is marked status='cancelled-duplicate' with a cancelled-duplicate log row, no second ownership is inserted, no purse is deducted, and advanceNominator is NOT called by the duplicate path

acceptanceCriteria.given: An active session whose only squad-not-full team just sold their final-slot player
acceptanceCriteria.when: advanceNominator runs and no other team has open slots
acceptanceCriteria.then: the session row transitions to status='completed' and nominationDeadline is set to null

acceptanceCriteria.given: Auto-completion at all-teams-full where one team finished with 0 GKP
acceptanceCriteria.then: an auditLogs row with type='AUCTION_COMPLETED_COMPOSITION_WARNING' lists that team and missing positions; completion is NOT blocked

acceptanceCriteria.given: A nominator whose nominationDeadline expires and whose wishlist is empty
acceptanceCriteria.then: handleNominationTimeout returns 'penalised', a teamPenalties row is inserted with incurredCycle=session.cycleNumber, teams.penaltySlots increments by 1, and advanceNominator moves on

acceptanceCriteria.given: A nominator whose nominationDeadline expires with a wishlist where the top entry is owned and the 2nd entry is unowned and affordable
acceptanceCriteria.then: the 2nd entry is auto-nominated (auctionBids row created, currentHighBidderId=nominator), no penalty row is inserted, and SSE emits 'auto-nominated'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A squad-full nominator whose deadline expires
acceptanceCriteria.then: no auto-nomination, no penalty, advanceNominator runs and SSE emits 'skipped-full'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team A authenticated
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Not authorized'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A wishlist with two rows for the same fplElementId (priorities 3 and 7)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response contains the priority=3 row only, and the priority=7 row is deleted from DB

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team POSTs /api/auction/wishlist with a players array of 5 entries where 2 already exist in their wishlist
acceptanceCriteria.then: response is {success:true, inserted:3, skipped:2} and the 3 new rows have priorities maxExisting+1..maxExisting+3

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team PATCHes /api/auction/wishlist with items=[{id:A,priority:2},{id:B,priority:1}]
acceptanceCriteria.then: auctionWishlists row A now has priority=2 and row B has priority=1

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team DELETEs /api/auction/wishlist with id and a teamId that doesn't match the row owner
acceptanceCriteria.then: no rows are deleted (the AND on teamId protects cross-team deletion)

acceptanceCriteria.given: A team's auction squad with one 'released' ownership and 14 'active' ownerships
acceptanceCriteria.then: the squad array has 14 entries (released row excluded), activeCount=14

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team with bonusSlots=0, penaltySlots=0, initialAuctionCompleted=false
acceptanceCriteria.then: slotStatus.canUnlock=false, slotStatus.unlockBlockedReason='initial auction in progress', slotStatus.nextUnlockCost=10_000_000

acceptanceCriteria.given: A team with bonusSlots=1, penaltySlots=1
acceptanceCriteria.then: that team's effectiveMax=15 (15+1-1)

acceptanceCriteria.given: GET /api/auction/players?leagueId=X&pageSize=200
acceptanceCriteria.then: pageSize is clamped to 100

acceptanceCriteria.given: GET /api/auction/players?leagueId=X&gameweek=0 or gameweek=39
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'gameweek must be 1-38'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A league whose only session is type='initial' status='completed' with 4 unsold bids and a mini-auction session created today with 2 unsold bids
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response surfaces only the 2 unsold bids from the most-recent session (createdAt desc)

acceptanceCriteria.given: A session with 3 sold bids, 2 unsold bids, 1 open bid, 1 cancelled-duplicate bid
acceptanceCriteria.then: exactly 5 bids are returned (sold+unsold only) ordered newest-first with logs[] populated

acceptanceCriteria.given: An unauthenticated request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 200 with {live, leagueId, sessionId, status}; live=true iff the league has an active or paused session

acceptanceCriteria.given: GET /api/auction/live-status with neither leagueSlug nor leagueId
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'leagueSlug or leagueId is required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A user without admin scope on a league
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Forbidden'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin POSTs resetTo='mini-X' or any non-{initial|mini-N} value
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'resetTo must be "initial" or "mini-N"'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A league with sessions, ownerships, scores, trades, club ownerships, penalties and a populated wishlist
acceptanceCriteria.then: all auction tables for the league are emptied EXCEPT auctionWishlists; every team's purse equals initialBudget and penaltySlots/bonusSlots=0

defects.title: reset-auction 'initial' leaves orphan teamSlotUnlocks ledger rows
defects.description: POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-auction with resetTo='initial' (src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-auction/route.ts:38-83) wipes auctionBids, auctionSessions, auctionOwnership, auctionClubOwnership, teamPenalties, auctionScores and tradeProposals and resets teams.bonusSlots=0, but does NOT delete the teamSlotUnlocks audit/finance ledger rows for the league. The sibling restore-auction route DOES delete teamSlotUnlocks (src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/restore-auction/route.ts:372), proving the table is part of auction state.
defects.expectedBehaviour: resetTo='initial' should DELETE FROM teamSlotUnlocks WHERE leagueId = ? so the finance ledger is fully wiped alongside teams.bonusSlots=0.
defects.actualBehaviour: After resetTo='initial' the teamSlotUnlocks rows for the league survive. The finance UI / module 11 ledger will still show 'Slot Unlock' £10M / £20M / £30M outflows that no longer correspond to any state.
defects.notes: Fix is one extra line: await db.delete(teamSlotUnlocks).where(eq(teamSlotUnlocks.leagueId, leagueId)); placed alongside the other deletes. Risk: low — the table is purely an audit log. Impact: re-runs of a league's initial auction produce duplicate/phantom finance entries which is misleading to admins/teams. [DEV] Self-verified: tsc clean. [QA-VERIFIED]: 2026-05-27 — pinning TC(s) inverted. [BA-UPDATED]: 2026-05-27 — BR/AC text refreshed.
defects.resolution: POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-auction now also deletes teamSlotUnlocks rows for the league (src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-auction/route.ts:51-58). Without this, a full reset left ghost 'Slot Unlock' outflows in the finance ledger that no longer matched any team's bonusSlots (which the same handler resets to 0). The reset now wipes auction state, the slot-unlock audit trail, and the team economy columns together so the ledger and team state stay consistent.

defects.title: simulateAuction ignores team bonusSlots when capping squad size
defects.description: simulateAuction computes per-team cap with `effectiveMaxSquadSize(penaltySlots)` and never passes bonusSlots (src/lib/formats/auction/simulate.ts:108-111). Because effectiveMaxSquadSize defaults bonusSlots to 0 (src/lib/formats/auction/squad-rules.ts:23), a simulated team that had bonusSlots>0 at session-start is silently capped at 15 minus penalty slots.
defects.expectedBehaviour: The simulator should pass team.bonusSlots so simulated squads can grow to 15 + bonusSlots - penaltySlots, matching the live auction's effective cap.
defects.actualBehaviour: Simulated leagues with pre-unlocked bonus slots never fill them. The post-auction state misrepresents what a live auction would have produced.
defects.notes: Trivial fix: pass team.bonusSlots ?? 0 as the second arg. The MAX_SQUAD_SIZE round counter also needs to extend past 15 to fill unlocked slots — the loop hard-codes 15. Two-line change. [DEV] Self-verified: tsc clean. [QA-VERIFIED] Pinning TC(s) inverted. [BA-UPDATED] BR/AC text refreshed.
defects.resolution: simulateAuction now passes both penaltySlots AND bonusSlots to effectiveMaxSquadSize (src/lib/formats/auction/simulate.ts:109-115). A simulated team that pre-bought slot 16/17/18 now drafts up to its full purchased squad size; previously the bonusSlots column was silently ignored and the cap stayed at 15.

defects.title: Session create accepts negative/zero bidTimerSeconds and nominationTimeoutSeconds
defects.description: POST /api/auction/session action=create stores admin-supplied bidTimerSeconds and nominationTimeoutSeconds verbatim with only a nullish-coalesce default (src/app/api/auction/session/route.ts:218-221, 283-287). There is no positive-integer / sane-range validation.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Both fields should be validated as positive integers within sensible bounds (e.g. 5–300 seconds) and rejected with 400 otherwise.
defects.actualBehaviour: An admin can save bidTimerSeconds=-5 or 0; every nomination/bid will then expire instantly when started, effectively bricking the auction.
defects.notes: Add an input guard: if either is provided, require Number.isInteger && >= 5 && <= 300 (or similar). Low risk — purely additive validation. [DEV] Self-verified: tsc clean for the touched file. [QA-VERIFIED] Inverted pinning TC(s). [BA-UPDATED] BR/AC text refreshed.
defects.resolution: Added positive-integer range validation for bidTimerSeconds (5-600) and nominationTimeoutSeconds (5-3600) in POST /api/auction/session action=create (src/app/api/auction/session/route.ts:163-178). Out-of-range or non-integer values return HTTP 400 with the explicit range message. Undefined values still fall back to the existing defaults (20s / 60s).

testCases.scenario: resetTo='initial' empties auction tables (except wishlists) and resets purse/slots
testCases.preconditions: League with sessions, ownerships, scores, trades, club ownerships, penalties, wishlists
testCases.expectedResult: All listed tables empty for league; auctionWishlists rows preserved; every team purse=initialBudget; penaltySlots=0; bonusSlots=0; totalSpent=totalIncome=totalRefunds=0
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: resetTo='mini-2' rolls back cycle 2+ only
testCases.preconditions: Sessions for cycles 0,1,2 with ownerships acquired in each
testCases.expectedResult: Cycle=2 session and its bids/logs deleted; cycle-2 sold ownerships deleted; cycles 0,1 sessions+ownerships remain; teams.totalSpent recomputed from surviving active ownerships; penaltySlots=0; wishlists preserved
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: reset-auction wipes teamSlotUnlocks alongside auctionOwnership / teamPenalties / teams.bonusSlots
testCases.preconditions: League has teamSlotUnlocks rows for slots 15 and 16 (2 rows)
testCases.expectedResult: After POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/reset-auction with action='initial' on a league that previously had teamSlotUnlocks rows: SELECT * FROM team_slot_unlocks WHERE leagueId=L returns 0 rows; teams.bonusSlots=0 for every team; the finance ledger no longer shows 'Slot Unlock' outflows from the previous auction run.
testCases.author: qa-tester
testCases.notes: [QA-VERIFY] Updated post-DEF-AUC-001 fix on 2026-05-27 — retagged Regression -> Positive.

testCases.scenario: Mini reset preserves wishlists
testCases.preconditions: Team has wishlist rows; mini-2 session exists
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Owned top-priority is skipped (NOT deleted)
testCases.expectedResult: P2 was nominated; P1 row still exists in the wishlist (NOT auto-deleted by skip logic)
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: All wishlist entries unaffordable/owned → falls through to penalty
testCases.preconditions: Wishlist exists but every entry is owned by others or unaffordable
testCases.expectedResult: autoNominateFromWishlist returns false; penalty applied; SSE 'penalised'
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: applyNominationPenalty inserts row tagged with cycleNumber and bumps penaltySlots
testCases.preconditions: Session cycleNumber=2; team A about to be penalised
testCases.expectedResult: teamPenalties row with teamId=A, sessionId=session.id, incurredCycle=2, redeemedAt=null; teams.penaltySlots incremented by 1
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: simulateAuction respects bonusSlots so pre-purchased slot 16/17/18 teams fill their purchased squad cap
testCases.preconditions: Simulated league; one team pre-configured with bonusSlots=2
testCases.expectedResult: For a simulated league where one team has bonusSlots=2 (slots 16+17 unlocked), simulateAuction drafts up to 17 active ownership rows for that team. Other teams with bonusSlots=0 still cap at 15. Penalty slots still subtract as before.
testCases.author: qa-tester
testCases.notes: [QA-VERIFY] Updated post-DEF-AUC-002 fix on 2026-05-26 — retagged Regression -> Positive.

testCases.scenario: session create rejects zero / out-of-range nominationTimeoutSeconds with 400
testCases.expectedResult: POST /api/auction/session with nominationTimeoutSeconds=0 or 99999 returns HTTP 400 'nominationTimeoutSeconds must be an integer between 5 and 3600'. No auctionSessions row inserted. Undefined value still defaults to 60s.
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Single 'waiting' event when nothing changes
testCases.preconditions: Active session with no open bid; nominationDeadline=now+30s
testCases.expectedResult: Exactly one 'waiting' event with currentNominatorId and nominationDeadline; subsequent polls do NOT re-emit while snapshot is unchanged
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Heartbeat event fires every 15s on idle connection
testCases.preconditions: SSE connected to active session, no activity
testCases.expectedResult: At least one 'heartbeat' event within window
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Two SSE consumers race to claim a nomination timeout; only one wins
testCases.preconditions: Two SSE clients on active session; nominationDeadline is about to lapse
testCases.testData: Synchronised connections to ensure both polls fire on the same boundary
testCases.expectedResult: advanceNominator runs exactly ONCE; only one teamPenalties row inserted (if penalty path); only one client emits 'penalised'/'auto-nominated'/'skipped-full'
testCases.author: qa-tester

testCases.scenario: Wishlist returned ordered by priority asc

testCases.expectedResult: Response items ordered by priority asc (1, 2, 3)
